title: Streaming examples audit matrix (SDKs + docs) — working sheet
content:
Working audit matrix for: refresh developer-facing examples across SDKs + docs for (1) streaming, (2) tool calling, (3) structured output (JSON schema).

How to use this sheet
- “Status” = current assessment of snippet behavior when copy/pasted against latest released SDK as of 2025-02-28.
- “Mismatch type” categories: event naming, delta assembly, tool payload shape, tool result message shape, structured output schema, version skew, docs UI (tabs), import/env var issues.
- “Priority” rubric:
  - P0: broken / misleading / causes support tickets
  - P1: works but inconsistent with canonical model or missing key pitfalls
  - P2: stylistic / minor improvements

Assumed canonical direction (in-progress, aligns to Confluence conventions draft)
- Streaming: examples iterate events, assemble final message content from deltas, and handle errors/disconnects explicitly.
- Tool calling: examples show tool definitions, parse/validate args, support parallel tool calls, and send tool-result messages back.
- Structured output: examples use JSON schema constraints, validate output, and include retry/fallback guidance (models may emit invalid JSON).

Sheet 2 — Key mismatches (summary)
1) Delta assembly is inconsistent (Python/Go show naive print; TS uses transport-level SSE framing).
2) Tool-call arguments can arrive incrementally; many samples parse JSON too early.
3) Tool result message shape differs across languages and docs.
4) Structured output samples assume valid JSON without validation/retry.
5) Docs UI issues (code tabs) cause wrong-language copy/paste.

Sheet 3 — Priority P0 list (current)
- A01 Python README streaming assembly
- A03 Python streaming tool args buffering
- A08 TS tool types compile failure
- A11 Go README streaming loop
- A15 docs code tabs broken (mobile)
- A17/A18 docs tool-calling payload + pitfalls
- A20 docs structured output validation + retry
- A21 quickstart env vars incorrect
- A28 API reference tools schema incorrect
- A29/A30 parity lock on event + tool-result naming

Sheet 4 — Open questions (need decisions)
- Event naming: do we standardize on “message_delta” vs “content_delta” in docs examples? (Currently mixed.)
- Tool result message role/name fields: should we show a dedicated role “tool” vs “assistant” with tool_results attached? (Need Brian Murphy confirmation.)
- Structured output guarantees: how strongly can we claim schema adherence per model family? (PM-413; coordinate w/ Applied ML.)
- Compatibility callouts: where to place OpenAI-compat differences without confusing new users?

Sheet 5 — Notes from support + SE (quick copy)
- SUP-18421: customers seeing truncated tool args mid-stream; fix = buffer tool args until tool call is complete; log partial args and request_id.
- SUP-18436: structured output JSON parse errors; fix = validate, retry with temperature=0, and if still invalid, fallback to “best-effort parse + user-visible error handling.”
- SE: customers expect “parallel tool calls” to be automatic; examples must show explicit Promise.all / goroutines and re-submit tool results.

Next update cadence
- Update this sheet after each cross-repo merge (SDK + docs) and before cutting SDK releases (Connor O’Brien coordinating).
